ad-algĭdus , a, um, adj. ad, intens.,
I.very cold, chilly; of climate: “adalgidum maxime,” Fronto, Ep. ad M. Caes. 2, 9, p. 54 Mai; in Naev. ap. Cic. Or. 45, 152, Clussman would read adalgidum for atque algidum (B. and K.).
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
